hero.name: Víctor Manuel Gómez Álvarez
hero.intro: I build web applications with C# and .NET on the backend and React on the frontend.

items.name: Coasterdle
items.summary: A Wordle-style guessing game set in amusement parks. It is being built right now.

items.name: SQUARED
items.summary: A simple game where you fit a growing rectangle inside a frame, without falling short or going over. Published on Google Play.

items.name: GYM_RECORDS
items.summary: An Android app to log workouts and meals, and to check whether routines and diet help you reach your goals. Pending: I want to see it through.

I take part in the migration of an internal application from .NET Framework 4.7 to .NET 10, and I lead its technical side. The modules move from MVC to a headless architecture, with an API and React, on a modular monolith. I set up the deployments and pipelines with GitLab CI, built the billing module and bring AI agents into the development workflow.

I modernised an accounting system in Angular, with .NET endpoints. I also wrote a Python server that collected BLE data from gym devices and relayed it over WebSockets, and a WPF desktop app that showed that activity in real time.

projects.text: A polished watch is the result of all its parts, from the largest to the smallest. A project is no different: it comes from all my skills working together.

experience.text: Time passes like the hands of a watch, and that time is what builds experience after each challenge.

stack.text: Just as the mechanism makes the whole watch work, a developer’s stack does the same for their projects.

evolution.text: A new strap renews a watch on the outside while the mechanism keeps being refined inside. This website evolves the same way: the look changes and, in the meantime, what is inside improves.

contact.text: The watchmaker leaves a signature on the case back. Here is mine, and how to get in touch with me.
